widgets_values: 参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就关掉下面的开关

如果只要单采那就不要开启二阶段采样，分辨率选择器里选择你要的分辨率大小，推荐0.9，直出720p视频。
如果要开二阶段采样，那一阶段的分辨率就要调小，推荐0.4，先用低分辨率快速跑完一采，然后再用较低的步数再二次采样，此时二次采样就可以将分辨率拉高，根据自己的配置和需求来调（太高了也会影响速度）

PS：本地跑的话，可以先不开二采，先用一采来快速抽卡，抽到满意的，把种子锁定然后开二采来强化。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, high-fashion editorial, a medium-wide shot frames a tall Asian female model with sleek long black hair, sculpted cheekbones, and flawless glossy makeup, wearing a crisp white high-end silk blouse with the top buttons loosely undone, a bright red mini skirt, sheer nude stockings, and white pointed high heels, her long bare legs emphasized by the thigh-length skirt. She stands against a seamless dark-grey studio backdrop with large softbox lighting from the front and a cool rim light tracing her silhouette, a faint haze drifting through the light beams. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she slowly turns her body toward the lens, one hand sliding down to her hip, the silk blouse and skirt catching the light with each subtle movement. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of her torso, legs, and face as she tosses her hair back with one hand, tilting her head slightly and shifting her weight to one hip, the red mini skirt swaying and the white heels lifting her posture. The camera arcs around her with small amplitude at slow speed while she runs her fingertips along the collar of the blouse, her gaze following the camera with a confident, composed expression. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of her face and shoulders as she lifts her chin, fixes her eyes directly into the lens, and lets a subtle, knowing smile form at the corners of her lips. The camera pushes in slowly with very small amplitude, then holds a static shot as she brushes a strand of hair from her cheek and holds the final editorial pose until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: Quiet studio ambience with a low ventilation hum underneath, soft fabric rustling gently as she moves, and a faint airy whoosh from the studio fan passing through the frame.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic fashion-runway track at a moderate tempo with a steady four-on-the-floor kick, deep pulsing bass, airy synth pads, and crisp hi-hat accents; the energy rises subtly in the middle and ends with a clean, confident stop as she holds the final pose.

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, a high-end Chinese classical fashion-film look with a dreamy surreal atmosphere, a near shot begins exactly from <Picture 1>: the young woman with a high black bun tied with a flowing red silk ribbon, long red tassel earrings, and a translucent wine-red to orange-red gradient silk Hanfu with wide sleeves, framed by blooming pink cherry-blossom branches against a dusk sky fading from deep blue to pink-purple. She keeps her original pose, expression, lighting, and composition, one hand raised near her chest with fingertips gently curved. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as a soft breeze lifts the red ribbon and the tassels sway; she slowly turns her gaze from the side toward the lens. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of her face, the cherry blossoms softly blurred behind her. She tilts her head slightly and brushes a strand of hair from her cheek, her dark eyes looking into the lens with a quiet, thoughtful expression, the red silk ribbon drifting across her shoulder. The camera holds a static shot as her lips part slightly. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a full-body wide shot revealing her entire figure standing beneath the cherry blossoms, the layered Hanfu skirt and wide sleeves flowing in the breeze as she takes one graceful step forward and turns her body. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed while cherry petals spiral down around her, the red ribbon streaming behind her against the twilight sky. [Shot 4] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of her face and shoulders as she lifts her chin, fixes her eyes directly into the lens, and lets a faint, elegant smile form at the corners of her lips. The camera pushes in slowly with very small amplitude, then holds a static shot as a single petal drifts across the foreground and she holds the final pose until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: A gentle breeze passes through the cherry blossoms with a soft rustle of silk as she moves, and a few petals whisper through the air; the tassels sway almost silently in the twilight.

non_diegetic_music: A guofeng R&B track at a laid-back moderate tempo, combining plucked guzheng and pipa phrases with a smooth R&B groove built on a soft kick, swung hi-hats, and warm sub-bass; the rhythm stays relaxed and groovy throughout, with the plucked strings becoming more prominent in the final shot and ending on a sustained, fading note.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female doctor from <Picture 1>, with dark hair tied back in a neat bun, wearing a white doctor's coat over a green medical scrub top and a stethoscope around her neck.
<Subject 2> is the young male patient from <Picture 2>, with short black hair, wearing a solid blue t-shirt and black trousers.
<Subject 3> is the hospital outpatient consultation room from <Picture 3>, featuring a light-beige wall, a desk with a computer monitor, medical posters, a window with blinds, and chairs.

summary:

detailed_description:
Live-action, realistic cinematic narrative style with natural daylight illumination inside a hospital room.
[Shot 1] A wide shot establishes <Subject 3>, the hospital consultation room. <Subject 1>, the female doctor with dark hair in a bun wearing a white coat and green scrub top, sits at the desk looking down and flipping through paper medical records on a clipboard. Across from her, <Subject 2>, the young male patient in a blue t-shirt, sits leaning forward, watching her face with an anxious and expectant expression. The camera holds a static shot for two seconds as paper rustles softly.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1), the female doctor. She slowly nods while skim-reading the pages. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in a gentle, warm tone with a steady, reassuring pace: <d>[Chinese] 嗯，不错，所有指标都非常好，没什么问题。</d> She finishes the line with a mild nod.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> (S2), the young male patient. He lifts his head slightly, his worried face instantly relaxing into a relieved smile. <Subject 2> (S2) says in an eager, lighthearted voice: <d>[Chinese] 是不是代表我彻底好了呀医生。</d> He rests his hands on his knees as the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward his smiling face.

overall_soundscape:
The soft rustle of paper pages flipping, light keyboard clicks from the background desk, and quiet indoor room ambience.
